notes: v319 — MANIFEST-DATE-0001 + SESSION-RECORD-NO-DELETE (owner, Nov 3, 2026): (1) The Manifest trusted its stored selected day forever; on the owner's phone mani_date held a corrupt year-1 value ("0001-11-02", later "0001-10-24" — the native date picker mangles it further on any touch), so the Manifest opened on year-1 days and showed no work. modules/manifest.js now validates every stored manifest date (mani_date, mani_from, mani_to): YYYY-MM-DD, a real calendar date, year 2020 through next year. A stored non-empty value that fails falls back to today AND is overwritten with today (self-heal), and the date onchange handlers store today instead of any value that fails validation. Absent/empty range ends keep the deliberate 'no dates picked' state (v211's honest empty note), untouched. (2) The Revenue day detail rendered the day's tracker-session card with no way to remove a session record — the owner's approved removal of today's phantom session (Nov 3, 9:00 AM to 5:44 PM, 0 km, 8.73 h; its $253.26 entry already deleted) was impossible in the app. The session card now carries the same two-tap Delete (Delete → Sure?) the day's entries/extras use, hidden while an edit form is open like theirs; the projection carries the record's raw sessions-store index, a tap-time guard re-checks the record at that index is still this day's session, and the verified write goes through App._store.set — the normal cloud-sync path, whose record-list merge honors the absence as a deliberate deletion so it cannot resurrect. Only the session record is removed; revenue entries are never touched. Nothing else changed. Gates: manifest suites 15 files + revenue suites 4 files + day-detail 33/33 + phantom-session-v314 20/20 run against the pristine web-318 tree first, then re-run in the final state: no functional assertion regressed anywhere. The consistent bump healed three stale ?v= pins (manifest-export 60/61 → 61/61 green, manifest-jargon-peg 33/35 → 34/35, manifest-names 15/17 → 16/17); the remaining reds are fixed historical pins only (jargon-peg wants webVersion 299, names and multiday want 255 / the v211 build, toggles wants the app.js tag at webVersion — app.js untouched by this release, revenue-autoprice wants webVersion 188 / the revenue 199 pin). A targeted smoke over the shipped code passed 16/16 (corrupt 0001-11-02/0001-10-24 healed to today, valid dates kept, unset untouched, Feb-30 and far-future rejected, the phantom-session delete removes exactly that record and leaves entries and other days alone). Verdict owed in his hands: the Manifest opens on a real day, and the Nov 3 session record deletes from the day detail.
